sections.title: Cloud and Globex VWAP context
sections.body:
Requested ES calendar: 2020-01-01–2026-10-30. This release uses only repository-retained pivots and exact-contract OHLCV; retained market data ends 2026-09-18. The actual eligible dates and coverage limits are saved in the source run.

Repository-retained ES data only; requested coverage ends 2026-10-30, while retained market data ends 2026-09-18. Missing dates/contracts and retrospective full-day eligibility limit generalization.

Historical pivot available_at remains unverified. Nominal 09:25 timing does not establish a historically executable pre-open signal.

Returned-without-EMA and eventual confirmation labels are known later. Already-aligned EMA6 is distinct from an actual new line crossing.

Signed displacement and excursions describe price paths. No entries, fills, costs or net profitability are tested. Broad slices are exploratory.

sections.title: Indicator context available at the event
sections.body:
The EMA20/50 cloud always uses completed five-minute bars. EMA6 uses three-minute bars. Globex VWAP accumulates one-minute HLC3/volume from 18:00 New York. Slopes are 15-minute changes; cloud width is the absolute EMA spread. Each grouping below changes one condition at a time rather than constructing an unrestricted small-cell cube.

EMA-cloud alignment requires EMA6 strictly on the event side, cloud ordering in that direction and both EMA20/50 15-minute changes strictly in that direction. EMA-VWAP alignment requires EMA6 on the event side and price on that side of VWAP. Combined alignment requires both. Already-aligned EMA6 can satisfy these alignment conditions; an actual new EMA6 crossing is a separate condition. Missing required state/slope remains unknown. Confirmation references use their own later state.
